content: Because we use the NRC VAD dominance lexicon to quantify denial of agency in the same way we use the valence lexicon to quantify negative evaluations of a target group, we again directly induce scores directly from target group label representation. We train another set of ridge regression models with word embedding features for each year, but now we fit the model to the NRC VAD dominance lexicon's scores rather than the valence scores.
